NAME: Webstream
DESCRIPTION: Search/stream web audio (YouTube, SoundCloud, archive.org, Freesound, Discogs crate-dig) as a Force sound-generator voice. Port of Charles Vestal's schwung-webstream for Ableton Move (MIT). Requires the separate ForceAudioIn addon to be enabled (arms the shared injection tap at boot, zero voices) - this toggle only starts/stops the webstream_host process itself, no LD_PRELOAD/acvs involved. Also requires bin/yt-dlp and bin/ffmpeg to be present in this addon's folder - see README.md/scripts/build-deps.sh. Autoload is deliberately unavailable: always start it after boot, from this page.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: module directory (module.json/bin source) - EDIT to your device's real mmPath, see README
